description: The state that motivates the whole feature: the query 'quota' is a word the user read on a page but never typed into a title, a group name or a note, so every index-backed section is empty except one incidental History title match. Before this feature the page would have stopped there. The Page contents panel sits below, scoped to Open tabs, with the note saying the button asks permission to read the sites you visit. Results themselves live only in memory for the page session, so they appear on the click rather than in this capture — the PageContentsSection scenarios carry the scanned states.
